card.name: Linking words before a population or condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, who, for, those, such and and, placed right before a named patient group or condition. Also fires on a digit starting a year.

modes.label: Linker before patient group
modes.description: A preposition or pronoun that introduces a group of people or a disease.
modes.example: Medicare, established in 1965, is a federal health care plan for<< those>> 65 and older, in addition

modes.label: Linker before a disease term
modes.description: A word like of, with or and just before a disease or condition name.
modes.example: Hypercalcemia Estrogen administration may lead to severe hypercalcemia in women<< with>> breast cancer and bone metastases.

modes.label: Year digit
modes.description: The first digit of a four-digit year in historical text.
modes.example: until at last, in <<1>>562, fully ten years after

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, with some suppression of career and funeral words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come just before a patient group or disease name.
